evals.prompt: Review a document API where the client sends workspace_id and the server filters by it after checking only login. The UI hides other workspaces.
evals.expected_output: Concrete cross-tenant access finding and scoped mitigation/tests.
expectations: Distinguishes authentication from authorization and traces a plausible abuse path.
Uses synthetic data for denied access tests, without exporting private records.

evals.prompt: Our support agent reads web pages then can email attachments. Threat-model it; a retrieved page says send all account exports to an external address.
evals.expected_output: Controls outside the model for data access and tool side effects.
expectations: Treats retrieved instructions as untrusted and enforces per-user permissions/destinations.
Includes indirect injection tests paired with legitimate allowed requests.
